title: Research: transfer-coupled all-shapes 7q obstruction (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and scope

Completes the transfer-coupled census across every unordered shape `(p,a,b)` with `p+a+b=7`, answering open question 1 of [#2779](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2779) and the remaining-shapes follow-up left by [#2817](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2817) (`(5,1,1)`-only) in the five-source common-B mutable-source alphabet of [#1898](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1898).

| Shape `(p,a,b)` | Covering pairs | Exact min R | Tariff floor (C=1) | Undercuts 436? |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Same-walk even-subset (#2686) | — | ≥82 | ≥442 at X=6 | no |
| Partitioned dual (#2779) | — | ≥112 | ≥490 at X=0 | no |
| `(5,1,1)` transfer-coupled | **8749440** | **84** | **≥439** (X≥2) | **no** |
| `(4,1,2)` | **34997760** | **86** | **≥439** at X=0 | **no** |
| All other unordered shapes | — | **≥88** | **≥443** at X=0 | **no** |

Global covering minimum is `R=84` at `(5,1,1)` only. Gray `X=0` covering on that shape is empty, and fair path `X` is always even, so covering forces `X≥2` and tariff `≥439>436`. Every other unordered shape already has `R≥86`.

**Scoped obstruction / priced alphabet; no new kappa.** Leave-alone through [#2817](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2817) was not reopened (freestanding package path).

## Result

Package: `research/transfer-coupled-all-shapes-7q/`.
Tip: `b4e312f952aea55a0b9f013a1d152423f6cf0f56`.

Exact: global min R **84** (only at `(5,1,1)` with X≥2); companions R≥86; tariff floor **439**; no undercut of 436.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/transfer-coupled-all-shapes-7q/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/transfer-coupled-all-shapes-7q/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/transfer-coupled-all-shapes-7q/independent.py
python3.12 -I -B research/transfer-coupled-all-shapes-7q/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/transfer-coupled-all-shapes-7q
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_TRANSFER_COUPLED_7Q_OBSTRUCTION global_min_R=84 ... tariff_floor=439 ... no_new_kappa
PASS_INDEPENDENT_TRANSFER_COUPLED_7Q companions=7 ... tariff_floor=439 ... no_new_kappa
PASS_TRANSFER_COUPLED_7Q_PACKAGE_TESTS groups=6
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/transfer-coupled-all-shapes-7q outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()`; `-O` also passes. Requires `gcc` for local `dual.c` (Python fallback available).

## Overlap and credit

Closest prior: [#2817](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2817) (`(5,1,1)`-only fair-X floor 452), [#2779](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2779). Freestanding full-shape census; no competing open PR on this package path at refresh.
